narrative.northStar: A clear dark workspace for finding the part that fits.
narrative.overview: The interface keeps part descriptions, technical evidence and vehicle context easy to scan. Charcoal layers and restrained orange actions preserve the user's dark-only direction.

rules.name: Evidence before certainty
rules.body: Keep AI suggestions and unverified seller details explicitly labeled.

dos: Use the shared shadcn primitives and semantic tokens.
Preserve the complete proportions of user photos.
donts: Do not fabricate listings or vehicle data.
Do not use decorative page-load animation.
